run_text_generation_server: run the gRPC text generation inference server with a specified model and optional LoRA adapters
start_TextGenerationService: start a TextGenerationService gRPC servicer with a model, cache, and server URLs
handle_prefill_decode: handle prefill and decode batch requests for token generation via the TextGenerationService
warmup_model: warmup the model with a batch to compute max supported total tokens and allocate quantization buffers
handle_signals: handle SIGINT and SIGTERM signals with the SignalHandler class for graceful server shutdown
